skill.name: push-to-sequencer
skill.description: Check an existing prospect list with Leadsets and separate contacts by verification status. Map custom fields and prepare CSVs or add eligible contacts to Instantly or Smartlead.
skill.summary: Verify, segment, and prepare prospect lists for Instantly or Smartlead.
skill.author: leadsets

security_audit.summary: The Leadsets verification connection sends prospect email addresses to an external service, as documented. The other flags match Markdown, passive links, or workflow terms rather than shell execution, environment access, or system reconnaissance. Contact handoff can share extra fields, omit suppression checks, and add contacts without checking whether the destination campaign is active.

remediation.issue: Verification sends prospect email addresses to Leadsets.
remediation.suggestion: Disclose the destination and fields before verification. Send only eligible email addresses through an authorized connection.

remediation.issue: Extra contact fields are included by default.
remediation.suggestion: Allowlist required fields. Show the selected columns and confirm the destination before upload or export.

remediation.issue: The workflow proceeds when no suppression list is provided.
remediation.suggestion: Require a current suppression source before campaign writes. Exclude suppressed contacts from campaign-ready files and keep the removal report separate.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not check campaign state before adding contacts.
remediation.suggestion: Confirm the intended workspace and verify that the campaign is paused before adding contacts. Use CSV export if the state cannot be verified.

semantic_findings.title: Extra Contact Fields Shared by Default
semantic_findings.description: The default mapping passes through every nonempty extra column. Campaign uploads and CSV exports can therefore include sensitive fields unrelated to the sequence.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The default mapping explicitly includes unlisted columns, and the upload and export steps use mapped fields. Actual exposure depends on the supplied data.

semantic_findings.title: Campaign Upload Without Required Suppression Data
semantic_findings.description: The workflow permits campaign uploads without a suppression list. An opted-out contact can pass verification because mailbox status does not establish permission to contact that person.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The instructions explicitly default to no suppression list and direct eligible contacts into a campaign. The sequencer may enforce additional controls independently.

semantic_findings.title: Campaign State Not Checked Before Upload

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The handoff and pre-return checks omit campaign state. Automatic processing would depend on the sequencer and the campaign settings.

content.user_title: Prepare Prospect Lists for Instantly or Smartlead
content.value_statement: Prospect lists can contain duplicates, uncertain addresses, and missing campaign fields. This skill checks addresses with Leadsets, separates verification results, and prepares campaign imports.
actual_capabilities: Normalizes email addresses, removes duplicates and malformed rows, and applies a supplied suppression list.
Checks Leadsets usage and plans verification batches around account limits.
Separates verified, catch-all, unknown, and invalid results.
Maps custom fields and flags contacts with missing required campaign values.
Adds eligible contacts through a connected sequencer or prepares separate CSVs for review and import.
Reports verification counts, removals, campaign additions, and records used.
limitations: Verification requires a Leadsets connection or API key and uses available enrichment records.
Direct upload requires an existing Instantly or Smartlead connection. Without it, the workflow produces CSV files.
The skill does not start or schedule campaigns, write outreach copy, or find replacement contacts.
Mailbox verification does not establish consent or guarantee delivery. Suppression data is optional unless you require it.

use_cases.title: Prepare a First Campaign Import
use_cases.description: Turn an existing prospect sheet into separate CSVs for review before importing contacts into a campaign.

use_cases.title: Check Campaign Fields Before Handoff
use_cases.description: Match source columns to campaign variables and flag records with missing personalization.

use_cases.title: Control a Client Campaign Upload
use_cases.description: Apply client suppression data and confirm the workspace, paused campaign, and approved fields before uploading verified contacts.

prompt_templates.title: Verify and Export a CSV
prompt_templates.prompt: Verify the addresses in this CSV with Leadsets. Export separate files by verification status without uploading contacts to a campaign.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: Review a list before a manual import.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Suppression Rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Remove duplicates and apply this suppression list before verification. Hold catch-all and unknown contacts, and export the verified contacts separately.
prompt_templates.scenario: Basic: Apply exclusions before preparing a campaign list.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Smartlead Field Map
prompt_templates.prompt: Map email, first name, company, and first line to my Smartlead fields. Report missing values and omit other source columns. Do not upload.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: Review personalization fields before import.

prompt_templates.title: Approve a Controlled Campaign Upload
prompt_templates.prompt: Apply my current suppression list and check Leadsets limits. Show the segment counts and proposed fields. After I approve, upload verified contacts only to the paused Instantly campaign. Export CSVs instead if you cannot confirm the campaign is paused.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: Review and approve a controlled handoff to a connected sequencer.

output_examples.input: Verify 120 contacts and prepare CSVs without uploading them.
output_examples.output: Received 120 rows and removed 8 before verification. Of the remaining 112, 90 were verified, 12 were catch-all, 7 were unknown, and 3 were invalid. Exported separate files for review. No contacts were uploaded.

output_examples.input: Add verified contacts with complete fields to the paused Smartlead campaign. Hold all other segments.
output_examples.output: Added 28 of 30 verified contacts to the paused campaign. Held two verified contacts with missing personalization values and five catch-all contacts. The campaign was not started or scheduled.

best_practices: Use an approved contact list and provide current unsubscribe and exclusion data before verification.
Review the field mapping and keep only the columns needed for the campaign.
Confirm the destination and paused campaign state before approving uploads.
anti_patterns: Treating a verified mailbox as permission to send outreach.
Combining catch-all or unknown contacts with verified contacts without review.
Importing the removed-row file or sharing it as a campaign-ready list.

faq.question: Which sequencers does it support?
faq.answer: It supports Instantly and Smartlead through the agent's existing connection. It can prepare CSV files when no connection is available.

faq.question: What input does it accept?
faq.answer: It accepts a CSV, a Google Sheet, a pasted table, or another skill's output. The list needs an email column.

faq.question: Where are emails checked?
faq.answer: Email addresses are sent to Leadsets for verification through its MCP connection or REST API.

faq.question: How are catch-all and unknown addresses handled?
faq.answer: Catch-all contacts are tagged or separated by default and can be held entirely. Unknown contacts are held unless you explicitly ask to include them.

faq.question: Does it start or schedule my campaign?
faq.answer: No. It adds contacts but does not start or schedule the campaign. Check that the target campaign is paused before uploading.

faq.question: Does email verification use credits?
faq.answer: Each email verification uses one Leadsets enrichment record. The usage check is free.
